authority.canonical_name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
authority.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

candidates.expected_title: Aspire - A Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industries
candidates.canonical_title: A Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industries and Entrepreneurship (ASPIRE)

curation.canonical_summary: ASPIRE supports entrepreneurship and innovation in rural and agriculture-linked industries by enabling Livelihood Business Incubators and related incubation and skill-development capacity.
curation.canonical_objective: Generate employment through scalable micro-enterprise creation, strengthen skills in new technologies, provide skilled human capital to nearby industrial clusters, and improve MSME competitiveness through innovation.
curation.canonical_eligibility_text: Eligible implementing organisations include Central or State Government agencies and institutions, existing Government training centres, industry associations, academic institutions, and experienced not-for-profit private institutions seeking to establish a Livelihood Business Incubator.

canonical_application_steps.instruction: Review the current ASPIRE programme requirements and submit the applicable proposal through the official ASPIRE portal.
